title: chore: add governance doc and PR compliance template

commits.message:
chore: add governance doc and PR compliance template

- Add GOVERNANCE.md covering project ownership, scope policy
  (no AI / no vendor SDKs / no general UI libs in packages or
  electron-demo), module ownership, CLA reference, AI-generated
  code policy, runtime dependency policy, and build-artifact rules.
- Update PR template with a Compliance section: CLA reminder,
  AI-assistance disclosure, new-dependency disclosure with
  license rationale, and explicit checks against committed
  build artifacts or secrets.
- Cross-link CONTRIBUTING.md to GOVERNANCE.md and surface the
  new compliance items in §3.2 PR checklist and §5 Security.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@noreply.anthropic.com>
